messages:
ashley: Heads-up — planning to merge release/2.9.0 into main at 10:30 PT. This will trigger terraform apply against prod-network (network + IAM). Deploy bot will auto-run. Can oncall confirm capacity + rollback plan?

mike: I'm oncall. Watching. Which workspace/plan are we running?

ashley: workspace=prod-network. Plan preview: https://ci.internal/runs/232-tnet. Changes: TGW attachments, a couple of route updates, and one IAM role replacement. PR pins provider to aws v4.0.2 in providers.tf.

sam: Recommend throttling deploybot to single concurrent apply for network changes. Also consider running iam-only canary first.

deploy-bot: [automated] Scheduled apply queued: prod-network. Est. duration 3m. Controls: concurrent_applies=1, failure_threshold=1. Rollback policy: snapshot-and-revert. Runbook: https://wiki/redwood/infra/terraform-rollback

nisha: Verified provider pin exists in the merge PR. I added a note to the release notes draft about the IAM change.

mike: Setting deploybot throttle to 1 and enabling canary on us-west-2a subnet. Initiating merge in 2.

ashley: Security note: iam role reduces assume-role TTL. @security-bot please flag if scope is too wide.

security-bot: @security flagged: new role action sts:AssumeRole with * principal. Please add condition: ExternalId or limit account id. Tagging @sam for remediation.

sam: The role is scoped to infra account only; adding aws:SourceAccount condition and reprovisioning. Will push update to PR now.

deploy-bot: Apply started (run id r-221) for prod-network. Streaming logs:

> module.tgw.aws_ec2_transit_gateway_vpc_attachment.attachment: Modifying...
> module.iam.aws_iam_role.cross-account: Replaced

If apply exceeds 5m, agent will pause and request manual review.

mike: Getting transient EIP attach error on one AZ: "error attaching eip: already in use". Pausing the run. @ashley do we want to rollback or attempt manual remediation?

ashley: Pause for now. Plan: try to isolate IAM changes to complete (iam-only apply) while we triage EIP. If iam-only succeeds, we can merge release notes and reschedule network finalization. If not, rollback. @mike you have go?

mike: I'll patch provider retry configuration (increase retry backoff) and re-run iam-only. Command I used locally: `terraform workspace select prod-network && terraform apply -target=module.iam -auto-approve`. Also bumped provider retry to 30s.

deploy-bot: Apply resumed (iam-only). Completed 6 resources. EIP attach still failing on az-a. Run paused and awaiting rollback decision.

nisha: Rollback. We can't leave network partial with missing EIP routing. Initiating rollback now.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated (run id r-221-rollback). Restoring state from snapshot s-78. Terraform commands executed: `terraform state push --force s-78` then `terraform apply -refresh=false -auto-approve` to return to pre-change state. Notifying #incidents in 5m.

ashley: Thanks. I'll update the release notes: "2.9.0 delayed — network apply rolled back due to EIP attach race; provider retry increased; will reschedule during next change window Wed 10:30 PT."

mike: Filing follow-up ticket INFRA-4567 for EIP attach root cause and provider retry improvements. Assigning to @mike and @devops-oncall.

devops-oncall: Acknowledged. Will monitor next scheduled window and keep an eye on provider patch rollout.
